task: Which TBS / Matra repos are enabled for Tower, and are their coordinator jobs registered (as of 2026-09-26 23:00Z)

steps.sql: select replace(json_extract(payload,'$.repository_url'),'https://api.github.com/repos/','') repo, count(distinct subject) issues from events where kind='work.issue' and ts <= 1790463600 and (payload like '%api.github.com/repos/jessstrom/matra%' or payload like '%api.github.com/repos/thinking-brain-school/%' or payload like '%api.github.com/repos/ariablinkbuild/matra-suite%') group by 1
